name: Diethylamino hydroxybenzoyl hexyl benzoate
description: Diethylamino hydroxybenzoyl hexyl benzoate (CAS 302776-68-7 ), widely recognized in the industry by its abbreviation DHHB, is an oil-soluble UVA filter used in sunscreen and cosmetic formulations. It delivers broad-spectrum UVA absorption, targeting the 320–400 nm range, and is valued for its photostability and compatibility with other UV filters. In suncare formulations, DHHB is used as a primary UVA filter. It helps meet regulatory SPF and UVA protection requirements in leave-on products such as sunscreens, day creams, and foundations. Its oil solubility makes it suitable for anhydrous and emulsion systems. In plastics and polymer applications, it functions as a light stabilizer to prevent UV-induced degradation in films, coatings, and molded parts. This ensures long-term durability for industrial materials. Coatings and adhesive formulators incorporate it to extend the service life of UV-sensitive substrates exposed to outdoor weathering. This prevents yellowing and structural failure in various applications. The product is supplied as a pale yellow to yellow powder or as a solution pre-dispersed in cosmetic-grade emollients for easier incorporation. It is available in cosmetic-grade purity, typically at ≥98%. It meets requirements for use in regulated personal care markets including the EU, where it is approved under Annex VI of the Cosmetics Regulation.
